$Comment: The Headless Horseman's hard ride, carried by each of his hard forms through its combat config's EntityEffects (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted_HM, CAE_Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_HM, Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head_HM), the way the game's hard Gobliterator carries Gobliterator_Hard_Mode: his own sword swings, his charge and every bomb he or his Head throws hit 40% harder. The volleys falling on the players are the fight's, not his, so they keep their own damage. It adds to his wrath (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Wrath) in his last phase. Amount is the extra damage as a fraction.
